name: motion-graphics-remotion
description: Remotion Studio project for the In Time Tec and FREEDOM films (editable text props, live preview, render).

scripts.render:intimetec: npm run sync && remotion render InTimeTec out/intimetec.mp4 --gl=angle
scripts.render:intimetec:4k: npm run sync && remotion render InTimeTec out/intimetec_4k.mp4 --scale=2 --gl=angle
scripts.render:freedom: npm run sync && remotion render Freedom out/freedom.mp4 --gl=angle
scripts.render:freedom:4k: npm run sync && remotion render Freedom out/freedom_4k.mp4 --scale=2 --gl=angle
